title: Product Design (Accessories) Intern, Spring 2027
location: Glendale, CA · in office Monday–Thursday, remote Fridays
note: Softlines accessories (bags, headwear, jewelry, eyewear) internship; seniors preferred, portfolio link required on the résumé. Reposted on Nov 23, 2026 after an earlier listing closed.

facts.duties: Build product mock-ups, trend and point-of-view boards and presentations; research seasonal trends and competitors; support design reviews and packaging approvals; manage samples.
facts.requirements: Enrolled in college (or in a Disney program) when applying; senior year preferred; studying graphic, fashion or product design with an accessories focus; Photoshop, Illustrator, Keynote; sketching and CAD skills; jewelry design experience is a plus; own housing and transport in Glendale; unrestricted US work authorization.
facts.apply: Apply Now button on the Disney careers page; portfolio review is required.
